entities.name: Trinar
entities.description: An arrogant Cathar of Nearheath in Gavony, from a respected family, described in Reika Eberhardt's journal.

entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: Author of the journal; steals from Trinar and is looked down on by him.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Region of Innistrad Trinar hails from.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Reika's origin, which Trinar considers inferior.

events.summary: Reika's thefts escalate from a trinket to stealing coins from Trinar.
